title: Starling Oncology, Inc. (STLN) Reports Q3 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
author: Zacks.Com
description: Starling Oncology reported a Q3 loss of $0.13 per share, missing EPS expectations of $0.07 loss by 85.71%, though the company beat revenue estimates with $169.77 million versus consensus of $168.41 million. The stock has gained 94.9% year-to-date but received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company missed EPS expectations significantly (loss of $0.13 vs. expected loss of $0.07), representing an 85.71% negative surprise. While revenue beat estimates, the substantial EPS miss and Hold rating indicate investor caution despite strong year-to-date stock performance.

title: Ultragenyx (RARE) Reports Q3 Loss, Lags Revenue Estimates
author: Na
description: Ultragenyx (RARE) reported a quarterly loss of $1.16 per share, slightly missing the consensus estimate of $1.15, with revenues of $173 million falling 6.11% short of expectations. Despite underperforming the market by 29.1% year-to-date, the stock maintains a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating based on favorable estimate revisions. The Medical - Biomedical and Genetics industry ranks in the top 44% of sectors.
